sources.name: DEC-280 synergy re-scan
sources.detail: Board-approved 2026-05-19 via suggest_tasks interaction. Four swaps from candidate pool + archetype recipe canon-recall: (1) Hidden Stockpile → Yawgmoth, Thran Physician — also fixes illegal CI bug (Stockpile is {W,B}); Yawgmoth is mono-B free sac+draw+removal+proliferate engine. (2) Emeritus of Woe → Parallel Lives — token doubler scales every recurring token source. (3) Reclamation Sage → Bastion of Remembrance — third drain trigger on enchantment body, harder to remove than Blood Artist. (4) Foulmire Knight → Reassembling Skeleton — persistent fodder for drain loops with Phyrexian Tower / Carrion Feeder.

sources.name: DEC-302 swap
sources.detail: Beanstalk Giant // Fertile Footsteps → Cryptolith Rite. Board-approved 2026-05-27 via DEC-302 thread. Cut: slow 4-mana basic-fetch adventure made redundant by Three Visits / Nature's Lore. Add: {1}{G} board-wide creature-tap-for-any-color enabler — redundancy for Springleaf Parade on the deck's primary X-drain mana axis, and extends color conversion to non-token creatures (mana dorks, Bloodghast, Reassembling Skeleton, commander, every aristocrat body). Hardens the win condition against single-piece removal on Parade.

sources.name: DEC-302 swap (2)
sources.detail: Cultivate → Enduring Vitality. Board-approved 2026-05-27 via DEC-302 thread. Cut: {2}{G} sorcery ramp made redundant by Three Visits / Nature's Lore / Tireless Provisioner landfall + the deck's dork suite. Add: {1}{G}{G} 1/1 vigilance enchantment creature — third board-wide creature-tap-for-any-color enabler (with Parade + Rite) on the X-drain mana axis, but uniquely a creature for affinity AND attacks-and-still-taps via vigilance AND persists back as an enchantment when it dies. Triple redundancy is intentional: X-drain wincon is the deck's primary closer and Parade/Rite are both single-card targets for spot removal.

sources.name: DEC-315 swap: cut Plague Wind, add Afterlife from the Loam
sources.detail: Plague Wind is strictly dominated by In Garruk's Wake (same {7}{B}{B} cost, same creature effect, Garruk's Wake additionally destroys opposing planeswalkers). Slot reused for Afterlife from the Loam, which exploits the Witherbloom affinity-for-creatures + Delve cost-reduction stack unique to this commander.

guideContent.strategyOverview:
Witherbloom, the Balancer is a {6}{B}{G} 5/5 Flying/Deathtouch Elder Dragon with affinity for creatures on itself AND grants affinity for creatures to every instant and sorcery you cast. The deck couples a wide-creature engine (tokens, aristocrats, recursion creatures) with generic-heavy I/S payoffs that scale with board state. With 6+ creatures in play the commander recasts for {B}{G} or free, and every I/S spell — X-drains, mass interaction, mass reanimation, tutors — becomes near-free.

The aristocrats half (Viscera Seer, Carrion Feeder, Yawgmoth/Thran Physician, Pawn of Ulamog, Pitiless Plunderer, Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance, Witherbloom Apprentice, Grave Pact, Reassembling Skeleton) converts creature deaths into card draw, drain, and treasure ramp. Token generators (Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Awakening Zone, Mycoloth, Tendershoot Dryad, Avenger of Zendikar, Sprout Swarm, Infestation Sage) replenish the board and keep affinity hot, with Parallel Lives doubling every token created. Recursion (Bloodghast on every land drop, Reassembling Skeleton for {1}{B}, Eternal Witness, Reanimate via Grave Researcher, Living Death) makes wraths and removal asymmetric in our favor.

Prepared-mechanic creatures provide free copies of key sorceries: Stensian Sanguinist generates Exsanguinate copies when an attacker connects, Grave Researcher produces Reanimate copies as our GY fills, and Leech Collector creates Bloodletting copies on each turn's first lifegain. Murderous Rider/Swift End staples removal to an affinity-boosting body. Cryptolith Rite backs up Springleaf Parade as the second board-wide creature-tap-for-any-color enabler, extending color conversion to non-token bodies (mana dorks, Bloodghast, Reassembling Skeleton, the commander) and hardening the X-drain wincon against single-piece enchantment removal.

Win conditions are two-fold: Exsanguinate / Torment of Hailfire X-drains (affinity-cheap on a wide board), and commander damage from Witherbloom himself (flying/deathtouch + Swiftfoot Boots; 3-4 hits closes). Mass interaction is asymmetric only: Sheoldred's Edict (each opponent sacs) and In Garruk's Wake (only opponents' creatures and planeswalkers). Afterlife from the Loam doubles as a one-sided multi-target reanimate finisher — affinity for creatures (granted by the commander) plus Delve stack on its {5} generic, casting it for roughly {B}{B}{B} on a wide board. The deck is Bracket 3 fair-power: 2 Game Changers (Necropotence, Bolas's Citadel), 3 tutors (Diabolic Intent, Buried Alive, Fauna Shaman), conservative manabase (no Cabal Coffers / Urborg / Nykthos / Yavimaya / Boseiju), no infinite combos.

winConditions.title: X-Drain Finishers (Exsanguinate / Torment of Hailfire)
winConditions.description: Primary win condition. Build a wide creature board (typically 8-12 by turn 6-7 via Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Awakening Zone, Pawn of Ulamog, Mycoloth, etc.). Affinity drops Exsanguinate's `{X}{B}{B}` and Torment of Hailfire's `{X}{B}{B}{B}` by the creature count. With 8 creatures and 10 mana available, you can cast a 10-Exsanguinate for just `{B}{B}` (affinity discount removes 8 generic; 10 mana left as X). Stensian Sanguinist's prepared trigger generates free Exsanguinate copies after combat damage.

winConditions.title: Commander Damage (Witherbloom)
winConditions.description: Backup wincon. Commander is a 5/5 flying/deathtouch — only 3 hits to lethal commander damage. With Swiftfoot Boots (hexproof + haste) and affinity making recasts cheap (free with 8 creatures), Witherbloom is hard to remove permanently. 4 attacks via 2 castings + commander tax handling closes a player.

synergies.title: Affinity + Wide Board Loop
synergies.description: Witherbloom grants affinity for creatures to all our instants and sorceries. Token generators tick out 1-3 creatures per turn passively, and each one further reduces every I/S spell by {1}. By turn 5-6 the board is wide enough that X-drains, mass reanimation, and removal become essentially free.

synergies.title: Sprout Swarm Buyback Engine
synergies.description: Sprout Swarm is `{1}{G}` instant with buyback `{3}` that creates a 1/1 saproling. Witherbloom's affinity grant applies to both the base cast and the buyback. With 5+ creatures, the buyback cost drops to {G} — cast at the end of every opponent's turn, the saproling joins our board, the card returns to hand, and next turn the buyback is even cheaper. Single best self-feeding card in this archetype.

synergies.title: Aristocrats + Death Triggers
synergies.description: Every creature death triggers Blood Artist + Zulaport (drain 2 in 4-player), Pawn of Ulamog (new token), Pitiless Plunderer (treasure ramp), and Grave Pact (forces opponent sacs). Sac outlets (Viscera Seer scry, Carrion Feeder pumping) convert tokens into value. Witherbloom Apprentice adds 3 more life-swing per I/S cast.

synergies.title: Prepared Engine — Recurring Free Sorceries
synergies.description: Three Prepared creatures each generate a copy of their attached sorcery on a recurring trigger. Sanguinist: Exsanguinate copies on combat damage. Grave Researcher: Reanimate copies as long as 3+ creature cards are in GY. Leech Collector: Bloodletting (2-life drain) on first lifegain each turn. All copies are sorceries we cast — affinity applies to each.

synergies.title: Parallel Lives — Token Doubler Across the Engine Cluster
synergies.description: Parallel Lives doubles every token created under our control. Bitterblossom's faerie becomes 2 faeries per upkeep, Ophiomancer's snake becomes 2 deathtouch snakes, Pawn of Ulamog's spawn becomes 2 spawn per non-token creature death, Awakening Zone makes 2 spawn per turn, Mycoloth's devour generates 2x the saproling output, Tendershoot's saproling becomes 2 per upkeep (still anthemed), Sprout Swarm cycles into 2 saprolings per buyback, Avenger lands 2x plants per land drop, and Bastion's ETB Soldier comes in as 2. Force-multiplies every passive token source AND every sac-drain trigger downstream (Blood Artist / Zulaport / Bastion / Witherbloom Apprentice all fire more often).

synergies.title: Yawgmoth + Persistent Fodder
synergies.description: Yawgmoth pays 1 life and sacrifices a creature to draw a card and put -1/-1 on a target. With Reassembling Skeleton (recur for {1}{B}) and Bloodghast (recur on land drop) the loop is mana-efficient: each activation draws a card, kills/weakens a creature, and triggers every drain payoff on the board. With Bitterblossom and Ophiomancer feeding free fodder, Yawgmoth becomes a draw-3+ per turn engine while clearing opposing X/1 boards via -1/-1 stacks. The {B}{B}+discard proliferate side compounds Bitterblossom's poison-counter potential against single opponents.

synergies.title: Springleaf Parade — Token-Board Mana for X-Drains
synergies.description: Springleaf Parade's static — "Creature tokens you control have `{T}: Add one mana of any color`" — turns every drip token (Bitterblossom faerie/upkeep, Ophiomancer snake/endstep, Sprout Swarm saproling/EOT, Mycoloth devour-feed, Awakening Zone / Pawn of Ulamog spawn, Infestation Sage insect, Tendershoot/Avenger plants) into a Birds of Paradise. With a 6–10 token board (mid-game floor by T5–T6) that's +6 to +10 any-color mana per turn — the missing complement to Witherbloom's affinity discount: affinity strips generic cost, Parade adds colored mana from the same wide board, jointly making `{X}{B}{B}` Exsanguinate / `{X}{B}{B}{B}` Torment of Hailfire lethal-X far earlier. Note: ETB X-mode tokens have summoning sickness and cannot tap for mana the turn Parade is cast; static effect kicks in immediately on existing tokens. Witherbloom's affinity does NOT discount Parade (enchantment, not instant/sorcery), so cast it at X=0 for `{G}{G}` (just the static) when mana-constrained.

synergies.title: Cryptolith Rite — Parade Redundancy + Non-Token Mana
synergies.description: Cryptolith Rite ({1}{G} enchantment) gives every creature you control — token OR non-token — `{T}: Add one mana of any color`. Two functions in the deck: (1) Redundant enabler for Springleaf Parade on the X-drain wincon axis. Parade alone is a single point of failure for the deck's primary mana-conversion path; opponents who Krosan Grip / Disenchant Parade collapse the Exsanguinate / Torment of Hailfire turn. Rite is a second copy at half the cost. (2) Extends the effect beyond tokens: Llanowar Elves, Birds of Paradise, Bloom Tender, Elves of Deep Shadow, Bloodghast, Reassembling Skeleton, every aristocrat body, and Witherbloom himself all become mana-of-any-color sources. With Bloom Tender out, Rite-on-commander taps Witherbloom for {B}{G}+ via Bloom Tender's vivid effect compounding off Rite-fixed colors. Note: like Parade, Rite is an enchantment and does NOT benefit from Witherbloom's affinity-for-creatures discount on its own cast — pay the {1}{G} sticker. Summoning-sick creatures cannot tap turn-of-ETB.

sources.name: DEC-302 analysis
sources.detail: Swap: Beanstalk Giant // Fertile Footsteps → Cryptolith Rite, board-approved 2026-05-27

synergies.title: Enduring Vitality — Affinity-Body Mana Engine + Persist Insurance
synergies.description: Enduring Vitality is the third creature-tap-for-any-color enabler in the deck, but the only one that pulls triple duty: (1) {1}{G}{G} 1/1 enchantment creature — body counts toward Witherbloom's affinity-for-creatures discount on every I/S spell (Parade and Rite are non-creature enchantments and don't). (2) Has vigilance, so it can attack into a wide pod and still tap for mana on the X-drain turn. (3) When it dies as a creature, it returns to the battlefield as an enchantment (still has the static ability but loses the body) — built-in persist insurance against board wipes, single-target removal, and edict effects. With Parade + Rite + Vitality the deck has three independent enchantment-or-creature-bodied copies of the same effect; the X-drain wincon mana axis survives any one piece of spot removal. Note: Vitality the creature gets affinity benefit when you cast OTHER I/S spells (it's a creature in play), but its own cast is not discounted (it's a creature spell, not I/S). Vitality returns post-death as enchantment-only (not creature), so further deaths do not re-trigger persist — first death only.

synergies.title: Skullclamp + 1-Toughness Tokens
synergies.description: Skullclamp's `{1}: Equip` on any 1-toughness creature converts a token into 2 cards when it dies. Bitterblossom (1/1 faerie), Ophiomancer (1/1 snake), Infestation Sage (1/1 elf → 1/1 BG flying insect on death), Awakening Zone spawn (0/1), Sprout Swarm saprolings — every one of these is a 2-card draw with Skullclamp.

synergies.name: Affinity + Delve stack on Afterlife from the Loam
synergies.description: Witherbloom grants affinity for creatures to every instant and sorcery you cast. Afterlife from the Loam's {5} generic is reduced by both that affinity AND its own Delve, the two stacking on the same generic cost. With ~3 tokens out and 2 cards exiled from the graveyard, Afterlife casts for roughly {B}{B}{B} from turn 4–5 onward. The token engines (Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Awakening Zone, Pawn of Ulamog) keep the creature count high so affinity is rarely empty, and Buried Alive / Fauna Shaman load the yard for Delve while also providing reanimation targets. The result is a one-sided multi-target reanimate that pulls the best creature from each opponent's graveyard under your control — selective removal plus a board of stolen threats in a single card.

highlights.name: Witherbloom, the Balancer
highlights.reason: Commander — 5/5 flying/deathtouch with self-affinity AND grants affinity to all your instants and sorceries. Powers the entire deck's mana curve.

highlights.name: Stensian Sanguinist // Exsanguinate
highlights.reason: Primary win-engine — recurring Exsanguinate copies on combat damage, affinity-cheap each time.

highlights.name: Sprout Swarm
highlights.reason: Buyback instant token engine that snowballs the very board state it depends on for affinity discount.

highlights.name: Necropotence
highlights.reason: Game-Changer engine. Trades life for cards at a rate the deck can sustain via Blood Artist / Witherbloom Apprentice / Sanguinist drain triggers.

highlights.name: Bolas's Citadel
highlights.reason: Game-Changer alt-wincon. Cast spells off top of library by paying life; pair with token board generating constant drain triggers.

highlights.name: Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
highlights.reason: Free sac outlet that draws a card and -1/-1's a target per activation. Loops with Reassembling Skeleton, Bloodghast, and any Bitterblossom/Ophiomancer token feed. Premium aristocrats engine.

highlights.name: Parallel Lives
highlights.reason: Doubles every token created under our control. Force-multiplies Bitterblossom, Ophiomancer, Pawn of Ulamog, Awakening Zone, Mycoloth, Tendershoot Dryad, Sprout Swarm, Avenger of Zendikar — and every downstream drain trigger.
